cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes, e.g. 45000000 (construction), 72000000 (IT services), 33600000 (pharma).

countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes of the buying authority's country, e.g. DEU, FRA, NLD.

fullTextSearch.title: Keyword
fullTextSearch.description: Optional full-text keyword or phrase to match in the notice.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only notices published after this date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many tender records (you are charged per record).

sinceLastRun.title: Only new tenders since last run
sinceLastRun.description: Incremental mode: remembers the newest publication date per filter set; scheduled runs return only new notices.
